emma: Quick heads-up — I'm sketching a short PRD for an alpha exposure of the new routing policy + version fallback logic. Goal: customer-driven scope for limited traffic experiments (0.5–5% tenants) to validate safety and costs before full rollout. Need help with: acceptance criteria, rollback heuristics, and experiment config.

devin: I can own the eng acceptance criteria. Proposed perf targets: p95 latency <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms on dedicated; error rate increase <= 0.2pp. If unmet for 10m we trigger soft rollback.

raj: SRE + oncall input: add infrastructure guardrails: rate-limited spike protection, cold-start spike detection, and a circuit breaker that flips if 5xx >= 0.5% over 5m. Also require a manual abort path for oncall with one command.

lisa: Product ops: we'll need a launch checklist: stakeholder signoff (security/compliance), telemetry sanity, smoke tests, and a customer opt-in list. Also define who the alpha tenants are (internal + 3 external customers).

sam: From metrics side: define primary metrics (latency, error rate, tokens/unit cost), secondary metrics (quality regressions via eval set). Need a small prompt deck (50 prompts) to run quality regressions per rollout bucket.

emma: Draft acceptance criteria (first pass):
- Safety: no new PII leakage alerts triggered by pattern matcher
- Quality: BLEU/ROUGE-style regression <= 2% on prompt deck OR no significant human-reported regressions in 24h
- Reliability: p95 <= 120ms, 99th <= 300ms, 5xx < 0.5%
- Cost: token cost delta <= +20% vs baseline model
- Observability: per-tenant traces + rollout dashboard live

devin: For experiments, propose small traffic buckets and pins:
```
experiment:
  buckets: [0.5, 1, 2, 5]  # percent of tenants
  duration_each: 48h
  metric_check_interval: 10m
  rollback_rule: >threshold for 2 consecutive checks
  pinning: tenant-level version pin (opt-in)
```

raj: Rollback criteria suggestion:
- automatic rollback if p95 or error rate breach persists for 20m across >50% of buckets
- immediate rollback if cascading errors detected (100ms increased tail + spike in 5xx)
- staged manual rollback for non-critical regressions

lisa: Edge cases to document in PRD:
- tenants with long-lived pinned sessions (how we evict)
- mixed routing when region capacity differs
- telemetry gaps due to private deployments (on-prem) — require local agent health pings

emma: Owner assignments: emma (PRD + customer comms), devin (eng acceptance + rollout infra), raj (SRE runbook + abort command), sam (metrics + prompt deck), lisa (ops checklist + alpha tenant list).

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: alpha-routing-policy-v3 -> staging. CI checks: 27/27 passed.

devin: I'll open the RFC doc and link experiments with a minimal YAML for ops. Can we get a fast review from sec/compliance by EOD?

lisa: Pinged @security and @compliance. They said quick pass tomorrow morning.

emma: OK — next steps: I'll finish PRD draft, attach the prompt deck, and post the RFC link in this thread. If anyone has strong objections to the rollback numbers above, flag now. :thumbsup:
